capture.help:
Screen capture
Drag to select a region. Drag inside the selection to move it, or drag its eight handles to resize it. Choose Select before adjusting a region after annotation. Arrow keys move the region; Shift+arrow keys resize it; Ctrl or Command increases the step to ten pixels. Entire screen selects the full image. Coordinates provides editable X, Y, Width and Height fields in image pixels. Rectangle, Arrow, Pen, Text and Mosaic annotate the selection. Choose a color and line width before drawing. Text opens an input at the clicked point; Enter commits it and Escape discards that text. Undo removes the last annotation. Copy copies the final image, Save asks where to save it, and Add to Chat attaches it to the originating draft when opened from chat, or the current chat when opened independently. When the selection surface has focus, Enter copies standalone screen and code images; captures started from chat attach on Enter. Escape cancels the capture. Tab and Shift+Tab move between controls. Alt+F1 opens this help; Alt+F2 reads selection coordinates and annotation count. Image contents are not described.
Select code in an editor and run Snapshot: Create Code Image to render the selection without capturing the screen. Code image accessibility view includes the selected text.
If macOS requires permission, Snapshot opens System Settings and a companion application card. Drag its application card into the upper Screen & System Audio Recording list and enable the app. Enter on the card copies its path for the system + picker. Return to Ash after granting permission to continue the screenshot automatically; follow the macOS prompt if a restart is required. Option+F1 opens keyboard help, and Escape cancels.
